reasoning: The tweet claims Haiti's TPS was granted following an earthquake 15 years ago and never updated. In reality, Haiti received a new, distinct TPS designation in 2021 following the assassination of President Jovenel Moise and a separate earthquake, not merely a continuation of the 2010 designation. The tweet's framing is materially misleading.

The tweet claims Pirro said all guns will be confiscated and threatens jail for law-abiding gun owners. In reality, Pirro's office stopped pursuing felony charges for carrying registered rifles/shotguns in DC and she affirmed support for legal gun ownership. Her statement about jail applies to unlicensed out-of-state firearms carried into DC, which is longstanding DC law, not confiscation.

The tweet claims students 'savagely attacked a teacher' during an ICE protest. Police confirmed the man (Chad Michael Watts, 45) was not a teacher or school employee, had no district affiliation, and was himself charged as the primary aggressor with two counts of assault causing bodily injury.

The tweet claims Trump 'made up federal permitting.' Federal permitting is an established legal term codified under the FAST-41 Act signed by Obama in 2015 (42 USC Ch. 55, Subch. IV), and the Federal Permitting Council operates at permitting.gov. Trump did not invent the concept.

The tweet claims a Washington State middle school principal was fired for letting students protest ICE. No credible source confirms the principal was fired. The Auburn School District confirmed the walkout was student-led via social media and not sanctioned by the school. The video also conflates footage from a separate Auburn incident involving a parent withdrawing her child.

The tweet labels the performance a 'dragon dance' but it is actually a lion dance (performed by two people in a lion costume). Dragon dances involve 10+ performers manipulating a long dragon on poles. This is a common but factual misidentification rather than harmful misinformation.

Mike Johnson states ICE administrative warrants are 'issued by an immigration judge,' which is false. ICE administrative warrants (Forms I-200, I-205) are signed by ICE officers, not judges. Under the 4th Amendment, these warrants do not authorize entry into a home without consent or a judicial warrant.

Same incident as tweet 3: the tweet claims students choked and beat a teacher. The man was Chad Michael Watts, not a teacher, and police identified him as the primary aggressor who was charged with two counts of assault.

The tweet says 'The Charlie Kirk case is solved, basically' with a video. Charlie Kirk was assassinated in September 2025 and suspect Tyler Robinson has been charged with aggravated murder based on DNA evidence. An existing note incorrectly claimed Kirk is alive. Without seeing the video content, it is unclear if the tweet's claim is misleading or simply commenting on the case progress.

The tweet posts a video claiming 'PM Modi is compromised' in relation to Epstein. Multiple fact-checkers confirmed the video is AI-generated by India's opposition Congress party. India's MEA dismissed the Epstein reference as 'trashy ruminations of a convicted criminal,' and no evidence establishes any Modi-Epstein connection.
